culture_rules.reason: Broad authored contact among the human kingdoms and established dwarf/gnome societies through commerce, diplomacy, and military cooperation. Native Common is already CLEAR wherever actually shared. These partial-comprehension links are gameplay extrapolations.

Long neighboring, imperial, military and hybrid-community contact on Draenor supplies partial Orcish/Ogre familiarity. This models culture-wide background and uses no current faction or personal history. Roots remain distinct in the FAR generator.

Established Durotaric, Darkspear and ordinary Tauren community identities supply reciprocal partial familiarity. Culture identity is the chosen coarse proxy, without an era gate or current Horde membership check. Highmountain and Taunka are not included by shared bovine heritage.

Broad Amani-derived forest-troll cultural memory of Orcish military and neighboring contact supplies partial Orcish familiarity. This is a deliberate culture-level extrapolation; it does not extend to every Zandali-speaking culture.

Goblin and Blackwater maritime/merchant communities encounter human, orc and troll markets. Partial familiarity is authored into the cultural background; Gilblin are kept separate. No tradition, wealth, faction, location or job tracking is required.

Nathrezim and Satyr cultural environments support partial familiarity with the broader Legion tongue when explicit learned Eredun is absent. Their own native tongues and FAR sounds remain distinct. This supplies no reciprocal Nathrezim familiarity to every Eredun speaker.
C07: Authored human maritime Goblin familiarity. The named roots do not select the entire Arathi community.
C08: Southsea and Northsea mixed-port familiarity. Orcish remains a separate review choice.
C09: Vol’dun and Zandalar caravan contacts; familiarity is direct and directional.
C09: Tortollan institutional travelers and scholars encounter human and Zandalari communities.
C09: Scoped Tuskarr coastal Common familiarity, without a universal maritime language pool.
C10: High Elf and actual descendants; Highborne and Nightborne are not selected by their older ancestry.
C11: Authored scholarly Thalassian contacts.
C11: Authored allied Thalassian contacts.
C12: Dark Iron Common and Fire-branch familiarity; no Elemental-family propagation.
C13: Illidari institutional contact independent of faith.
C13: Twilight’s Hammer cultural familiarity persists across conversion.
C14: Authored formative Scourge familiarity without fluency or reconstructed individual lives.
C15: Highmountain exchange; not every Taur-ahe speaker.
C15: Direct Drogbar familiarity with Taur-ahe.
C16: Exact Mogu historical institutional contact, not every Mogu speaker.
C16: Exact Zandalari historical institutional contact, not all descendant troll cultures.
C17: Scoped Sethrak regional relationship; no reciprocal implication.
C18: Broad Furbolg forest relationship; unavailable dialect distinctions are not inferred.
C18: Authored Night Elf forest contacts.
C19: Selected Pandaria Hozen contacts.
C19: Selected Pandaria communities, not every Mogu speaker.
C20: Kobold resource and patron exchange; no invented Kobold language.
C20: Authored Low Common familiarity retaining native Gnoll and no Common-family anchor.
C21: Exact transformed Suramar community; native Nerubian stays authoritative.
C22: Exact one-way Green Dragon cultural relationship; no generic Night Elf Draconic grant.

design_notes.facts: Pinned native culture and parent data is a static fallback; actual current game data wins.
design_notes.families: Authored baseline of seven shared comprehension families; other known IDs are singleton families.
design_notes.contact: Authored direct culture-group familiarity; not native game learned knowledge.
design_notes.ancestors: Host supplies current culture ancestry using native game facts; static parent table assists fixed-culture lookup.
design_notes.exclusions: An excluded culture or its descendant suppresses the particular contact rule.
design_notes.no_tracking: No individual histories, acquisition records, timers, political/marital state or location records.
design_notes.pandaria: Current Pandaren/Jinyu/Mogu culture assignments are language_mogu and therefore clear to other actual Mogu speakers. The historical Old Pandaren and Old Jinyu language IDs receive no new cultural links from imperial ancestry alone.
design_notes.contact_revision: Full accepted C/R/CF/TT/TD/CT/SP decisions. These are authored partial comprehension, not language learning, fluency, family anchors, or an exposure-history database.

language_common.label: Common
language_common.signature: Keep the varied human core, with measured dental voicing and small vowel turns. No theatrical accent or dialect biography.

language_low_common.label: Low Common
language_low_common.signature: Related human contours contract: reduced inner vowels and short, firm endings, without implying simple thought.

language_gutterspeak.label: Gutterspeak
language_gutterspeak.signature: Cant-like st/sk and tr/vr turns, slanted vowels and voiced hisses retain Common roots. A language, not a universal damaged-lung effect.

language_dwarven.label: Dwarven
language_dwarven.signature: Firm interlocking contacts and au/u depth suggest the ordered FAR cells; retain root consonants and allow substantial endings.

language_gnomish.label: Gnomish
language_gnomish.signature: Bright, precise ei/e vowels and tiny stop linkages separate neat Gnomish articulation from Goblin compression.

language_darnassian.label: Darnassian
language_darnassian.signature: Liquid elven interiors resolve toward open ae/ta/na endings. Keep recognizable roots rather than substituting ornate new words.

language_high_darnassian.label: High Darnassian
language_high_darnassian.signature: Extend the shared elven endings into balanced aela/nela/tala returns. Literal bounded endings suggest the FAR closing arch without new grammar.

language_elunic.label: Elunic
language_elunic.signature: Measured ea/eia/nia vowel returns and soft contact convey a quieter elven cadence; no compulsory piety or ritual timing.

language_thalassian.label: Thalassian
language_thalassian.signature: Retain liquid ae interiors, but finish with crisp s/ns contacts rather than the open Darnassian release.

language_shalassian.label: Shalassian
language_shalassian.signature: Compressed e/i interiors, a narrow medial contraction and lingering aai/tai/nai release suggest compressed centers and extended endings. Contraction never removes a whole word.

language_nazja.label: Nazja
language_nazja.signature: Hold ss/sh around an inherited ae/ia elven core. This coiling voice stays distinct from the dry narrow Sethrak bank.

language_qiraji.label: Qiraji
language_qiraji.signature: Weighty q/kh and kt/nk contacts bound broad aa chambers; readable fragments stand in for FAR articulated compounds.

language_nerubian.label: Nerubian
language_nerubian.signature: Organized tk/tch/ksh clicks and dry sk/nk catches remain jointed and precise. No apostrophe spray or new sign-language narration.

language_mantid.label: Mantid
language_mantid.signature: Slender i/ii nuclei and ts/zh/z buzzing edges keep these small units lighter than Qiraji and less rasped than Nerubian.

language_vrykul.label: Vrykul
language_vrykul.signature: Broad northern vowels, sk attacks and firm voiced endings; do not turn the language into a real-world accent imitation.

language_drust.label: Drust
language_drust.signature: Keep the northern shape with hr/vr breath, reduced centers and rough lingering th. No assertion of death or corruption.

language_apexis.label: Apexis
language_apexis.signature: Bright avian ii/ei/ai and repeated rhotics end in a clean ringing release. Ordered articulation survives the beak-inspired surface.

language_ravenspeech.label: Ravenspeech
language_ravenspeech.signature: The same avian range contracts into kr/sk/kh croaks, dark vowels and a final catch; never replace a sentence with caws.

language_orcish.label: Orcish
language_orcish.signature: Guttural gh/kh contacts, dark inner vowels and hard closure retain the lexical spine. Replace starter gater/grefore distortions with vater/brefore.

language_ogre.label: Ogre
language_ogre.signature: Round o/oo/ou mouthfuls, heavy voiced attacks and rolled returns; full syntax and the original intelligence remain.

language_draconic.label: Draconic
language_draconic.signature: Deep aa/au chambers and vr/zh/kh friction suggest layered dragon resonance while preserving root attacks.

language_furbolg.label: Furbolg / Ursine
language_furbolg.signature: Warm low aa/uu, breath-heavy wh/hr and hummed closures keep ursine resonance without making water into mater.

language_gnoll.label: Gnoll
language_gnoll.signature: Bright ay yelp turns collide with gr/kr/gh and ragged breath catches. Root s is retained instead of replaced by y.

language_wolvar.label: Wolvar
language_wolvar.signature: Compact wr/gn onsets and nk/rr closures carry a tight snarl, distinct from Gnoll bright yelps.

language_pygmy.label: Pygmy
language_pygmy.signature: Quick ei/i turns and small clean nasal releases; stature changes the sound conception, never the meaning or sophistication.

language_hozen.label: Hozen
language_hozen.signature: Bouncing ou pockets and rolled contacts with small lip-pop closures; keep the source proposition rather than add comic filler.

language_nerglish.label: Nerglish
language_nerglish.signature: Liquid brl/bl/gl chains and oo pockets suggest bubbling inner continuity. Retain b/t/ch roots so words stay decipherable.

language_quilboar.label: Quilboar
language_quilboar.signature: Nasal sn/ng pressure and gr/kh catches echo thorny snorting FAR compounds. Firm endings keep source consonants.

language_tolvir.label: Tol'vir
language_tolvir.signature: Processional aa/ae chambers and exact inscription-like t/dt edges; source articulation remains audible within an old ordered shape.

language_titanic.label: Titanic
language_titanic.signature: Discrete repeatable vowel cells and restrained returning endings suggest ordered architecture without borrowing FAR cells verbatim.

language_giant.label: Giant
language_giant.signature: Enlarge ordered vowel chambers into aa/oa/uu with substantial voiced afterweight. Preserve complex thought and normal sentence length.

language_tortollan.label: Tortollan
language_tortollan.signature: Rounded oi/ou cells return through ora/on. Preserve word attacks that the starter replaced, letting endings carry the unhurried cadence.

language_drogbar.label: Drogbar
language_drogbar.signature: Grinding dr/gr/kh centers deliberately release into oa/ta/na endings, matching FAR open finals rather than generic hard cavern speech.

language_tuskarr.label: Tuskarr
language_tuskarr.signature: Compact rounded u/uu with fr/rl attacks and stout nasal holds; keep colder compactness separate from broad Taur-ahe and rolling Tortollan.

language_maraudic.label: Maraudic
language_maraudic.signature: A muscular tr/z pulse and rolling ay with blunt dt/rn returns imply a galloping cadence through sound, without changing rhythm or syntax.

language_shathyar.label: Shath'yar
language_shathyar.signature: Asymmetric lth/vr/nh contacts and returning aa/yi pockets suggest alien friction; reduce starter nzhot tangles to readable nhot.

language_kalimag.label: Kalimag
language_kalimag.signature: Firm gr/t roots resolve into sonorant ta/un/ara returns, a coherent elemental mixture rather than the heaviest elemental voice.

language_ignan.label: Ignan
language_ignan.signature: Crisp kr/sk and k catches punctuated by eh/nh/sh breath releases. Preserve main roots while suggesting fractured ignition without new hyphens.

language_terran.label: Terran
language_terran.signature: Packed gr/kk/dt/nd/dg closures surround rounded low cores, remaining denser and more closed than Kalimag.

language_aquan.label: Aquan
language_aquan.signature: Connected ua/ou bridges and soft sl/vr links flow to open releases. Keep consonant identities that starter gl/ve obscured.

language_auran.label: Auran
language_auran.signature: wh/rh/bh breath groups and airy ae/ai, with softened dh/kh edges. Retain onset b rather than turn before into fefore.

language_sethrak.label: Sethrak
language_sethrak.signature: Dry ss/sz friction and narrow i/ii distinguish a desert serpent voice from Nazja inherited elven ae/ia.

language_vulpera.label: Vulpera
language_vulpera.signature: Nimble ei/oi and soft v/f contacts with little light releases. Keep word roots rather than turn every b/s into another consonant.

language_mogu.label: Mogu
language_mogu.signature: Stamped gr/dt/dg units and broad u/uu build a heavy imperial sound distinct from warm Pandaren and connected Jinyu.

language_jinyu.label: Jinyu
language_jinyu.signature: ua/eo eddies, ry/ny liquid-nasal links and soft open releases; retaining root stops improves readability of the flowing bank.

language_pandaren.label: Pandaren
language_pandaren.signature: Warm balanced ao/u and soft voiced contacts resolve into a restrained crisp dt beat, rather than universally nasalized ends.

language_eredun.label: Eredun
language_eredun.signature: Harsh kr/zh roots, weighty aa/uu and rough ng/th release remain kin to Draenei resonance while making no moral claim about the speaker.

language_nathrezim.label: Nathrezim
language_nathrezim.signature: Silken ae/ael interiors and controlled vr/zh/th/nr edges feel poised and unsettling. Voice alone reveals no scheme or private intent.

language_cursed.label: Cursed
language_cursed.signature: Hollow aa/oa returns with kh/wh breath and nh/eth catches. Preserve the starter lost w, so water remains whater rather than hater.

language_draenei.label: Draenei
language_draenei.signature: Patient low aa/ua/ei resonance returns through eia/na/ta, gentler and more connected than Eredun command edges.

language_zandali.label: Zandali
language_zandali.signature: Rolling zr/rr, voiced z and open ay/ta/na maintain a strong syllabic pulse. No real-world English accent or added status suffixes.

language_taurahe.label: Taur-ahe
language_taurahe.signature: Broad low aa/au/uu with hr breath and nasal/liquid returns, more spacious than Tuskarr compact rounded roots.

language_goblin.label: Goblin
language_goblin.signature: Pinched e/i, compressed inner vowels and sharp kr/z/bz/k edges distinguish market-speed Goblin from precise bright Gnomish. No forced comedy or greed.

far.design_authority: User essence direction, including body form. Sources inspire portraits; no copied official word-parser vocabulary.
